sources.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers
sources.snippet: In this work, we address these limitations by introducing TabRank, a reranking model for structured tabular retrieval that substantially outperforms both standard supervised fine-tuning and CoTGen distillation in generalizing to out-of-distribution table settings, including multi-table retrieval and financial-domain datasets such as TAT-QA.
